name: Packmaster Rethelros

abilities.name: Quick Shot
abilities.description: A basic ranged ability that deals moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Bolt
abilities.description: While Malthil is using "Scent", "Quick Shot" becomes "Ensnaring Bolt" instead. A basic melee attack that deals moderate physical damage and snares targets, making them easier to get caught by his wolf.

abilities.name: Directed Volley
abilities.description: Packmaster Rethelros fires a rain of arrows at a specific target, indicated by several back to back red circles, dealing continuous high physical damage.

abilities.name: Bear Trap
abilities.description: Packmaster Rethelros lays six bear traps down in the arena, indicated by red circles. Standing in one deals high physical damage, immobilizes you and deals low bleed damage over time.

abilities.name: Cinder Shot
abilities.description: Rethelros picks a target and lines up a shot which fires straight, indicated by a thin but very long red rectangle, dealing high flame damage. He can adjust his trajectory while channeling.

abilities.name: Bonfire
abilities.description: hits a lot of times for litle flame damage each

abilities.name: Totem Cast
abilities.description: Packmaster Rethelros blows a hunting horn, and summons a Protective Totem, which tethers itself to both bosses with a blue beam. They'll take less damage while this totem is up: destroy it to maximize your group's damage output. Having the tank drag the wolf to the totem may be a worthy endeavor if the Packmaster Rethelros isn't too close to it.

abilities.name: Blood Ties
abilities.description: Packmaster Rethelros and Malthil must be kept away from each other, or else they'll empower each other's strikes. This is indicated by massive red circles around both of them that appear when they are close enough to activate this effect. The tank should pull the wolf away while the group deals with the archer.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: Packmaster Rethelros can teleport away or closer to targets, or his wolf, using vanishing powder.

summary: Packmaster Rethelros is a Wood Elf and a member of the Recollection. You will face him within Malacath's Crown at the Oathsworn Pit, where he acts as the first boss, alongside alongside his wolf companion, Malthil.
